_note: Captain Kate McCue's own words only, each checked verbatim against the page in 'checked_url' (the page the wording was matched on; 'primary_source' when that differs from the listed 'url') on 2026-10-23.

_verification.method: Verbatim check on 2026-10-23: every source page was downloaded as raw HTML/PDF (Wayback Machine snapshot where the live site refuses non-browser requests) and each quote's text was string-matched against the page text, ignoring only quote-mark/dash typography. Aggregator pages (Goodreads, Wikiquote, quote listicles) were also searched for a primary source; quotes found only on aggregators are verified=false.
_verification.fields: per quote: verified, checked_url (page the wording was matched on), primary_source (when not the listed url), note, was (original text when corrected)
_verification.rule: Only quotes with verified=true may be used in game (tests/test_quotes_vv.gd).

quotes.text: I am the CEO of the ship.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: I use my platform to answer questions and normalize having a woman in this position.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: I believe the more open we are about it, the easier it is going to be for women coming up.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: I would just love to be the captain.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: My name tag only says "Captain."
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: Male captains are always addressed as captain.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: I worked hard for the captain title.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: So, I am living the dream now for both of us.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: It is definitely a marathon, not a sprint.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: I want to be able to show a behind-the-scenes view of how things really are on a cruise ship.
quotes.source: AAA Magazines Q&A with Captain Kate McCue, c. 2020-21

quotes.text: The Captain is like the CEO of the ship.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: The formula for a woman in the cruise industry to succeed is the same as in any industry.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: Surround yourself with diversity, be your authentic self, approachable and vulnerable.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: Be kind, be supportive, and pay it forward.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: You don't need to follow in anyone else's footsteps.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: Forge your own path by bringing your unique personalities and perspectives to every job you do.
quotes.source: Wartsila 'Women at the helm: Captain Kate McCue'

quotes.text: Everyone has a stereotypical idea of a captain and I'm missing some pounds.
quotes.source: CBS This Morning / CBS News, Sept 2015

quotes.text: I don't have a beard or a parrot but I think when the guests meet me they're pleasantly surprised
quotes.source: CBS This Morning / CBS News, Sept 2015

quotes.text: Well every sailor has to have a tattoo, right?
quotes.source: CBS This Morning / CBS News, Sept 2015

quotes.text: This is my anchoring to keep me grounded.
quotes.source: CBS This Morning / CBS News, Sept 2015

quotes.text: I think this is the greatest job in the world...traveling, meeting all these people, getting paid for it.
quotes.source: CBS This Morning / CBS News, Sept 2015

quotes.text: Becoming the first female American captain of a cruise ship has been a goal of mine for as long as I can remember,
quotes.source: Celebrity Cruises release, as quoted by Fox News, 2015

quotes.text: Just as with any leadership position, I believe that there shouldn't be a job that you're not willing to do.
quotes.source: ROL Cruise interview with Captain Kate McCue

quotes.text: I would not consider myself special.
quotes.source: Travel with Style interview with Captain Kate McCue

quotes.text: Being a minority because of gender, race, religion, cultural background, sexual orientation etc. is irrelevant.
quotes.source: Travel with Style interview with Captain Kate McCue

quotes.text: Everything falls to a captain.
quotes.source: Travel with Style interview with Captain Kate McCue

quotes.text: Even if the pizza is cold that’s my problem.
quotes.source: Travel with Style interview with Captain Kate McCue
